qualifying_updates.title: MCP Community Event foregrounds enterprise MCP deployment practice
qualifying_updates.short_factual_summary: The event agenda lists practice sessions on enterprise MCP deployments, the MCP 728 migration, governance for real-world agents, source-level findings from 100 TypeScript MCP servers, observability-stack MCP usage, and sandboxed multi-agent review swarms.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters: For this wiki, the local value is not broad MCP coverage but concrete operating practices: authentication and agent identity, tool management, observability, policy enforcement, scoped permissions, human-in-the-loop design, audit trails, static analysis of MCP server source, sandbox isolation, shared context, and multi-agent code review coordination.
qualifying_updates.local_practice_implication: Route broad MCP ecosystem and product/entity coverage upstream; keep local notes to governed MCP migration planning, source-level MCP server review gates, scoped authorization, audit evidence, observability integration, and sandboxed multi-agent review workflow design.
follow_up_notes: In a later ingest pass, consider whether current local retrieval-and-tools pages need a downstream practice note about MCP spec migration checklists and source-level MCP server scanning.

qualifying_updates.title: SEMI session describes production EDA copilot governance stack
qualifying_updates.short_factual_summary: A SEMI workshop session describes a production semiconductor sign-off copilot with multi-agent decomposition, RAG over manuals and API catalogs, agent skills, two-way MCP integration, tiered action approval, API-hallucination guards, prompt sanitization, audit trails, and on-premise or air-gapped local-LLM deployment.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters: The agenda is a domain-specific example of moving from a wrapper around an LLM to a governed agent harness. The local practice signal is the combination of context retrieval, tool execution, customer-extensible skills, approval tiers, prompt sanitization, audit evidence, and deployment constraints for IP-sensitive engineering workflows.
qualifying_updates.local_practice_implication: Route companies, framework, and MCP background upstream; keep local notes to harness architecture for IP-sensitive workflows, API-catalog grounding, approval classes, prompt sanitization, audit trails, and local or air-gapped deployment decision points.
follow_up_notes: A later ingest pass can use this as evidence for application harness patterns, agent environment readiness, and sensitive data controls.
Do not duplicate broad semiconductor, vendor, or MCP encyclopedia context locally.
